item.title: Kagemusha (WIP)
item.description:
Overview

Kagemusha is a first person stealth game set in a fictional version of edo period Japan. You are a ninja who has been tasked with assassinating a strange war general that resides in the mountains, but things don’t go as planned as mysterious powers wielded by the target catch you off guard and defeat you. With the help of mysterious beings, embark on a journey to get your revenge and stop this madman, honing your techniques and learning more about this new power.

item.title: Symmetry Survivors
item.description:
Overview

This small game was made for my first game jam, inspired by ‘Vampire Survivors’ its a survival based game where enemies will constantly attack you to overwhelm you, but during the night, the tide turns and you become the hunter. The game jam was one and a half days and it was the first time our team used Godot game engine.

item.title: OverWorked
item.description:
Overview

OverWorked is a short game where you, a new hire for a game company, need to pump out as many games as you can within your deadline. You are tasked with making the game entirely on your own and you best not fail or you’re fired.

This is project that one of my designer friends was doing for one of their submissions. I made the general gameplay loop for the game and all the code involved with that.
